body:
CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Living Map Phase 2 shipped (BACKLOG.md SECTION 377, docs/NORTHSTAR_LIVING_MAP.md): real classic-RTS creep aggro/chase/leash/reset (packages/livingmap/creep.h/.c, directly mirroring arena_game.h's own proven ArenaCampMinion shape -- DETECT-vs-HIT range distinction, leash measured from home not current position, reset to full hp only once actually home), a new hex_step_toward greedy-pathing helper (hex_grid.h/.c). TOWN_TYPE_WALLED_HAMLET now has real behavior (new PARENA/stdlib/ecowar/walled_hamlet_mod.prn): slower economy + lower raise threshold (defensive bias), much higher convert resistance (60 vs Frontier Village's 20 -- 'slow to flip', real and tested), and genuinely new 'shoots hostile creeps' defensive fire against the CreepRegistry (town_tick_with_creeps), stationary, garrison-scaled range/damage, real cooldown, never friendly-fires. Cards-tie-into-the-Living-Map mechanic shipped: Town.militia_bonus + town_apply_militia_boost (+1 militia/garrison raised per spawn tick per real card play, stacking, capped at 20) -- exactly matches founder's 'play it twice, villages put up three militia at a time' spec, fully tested; the real, honest gap is that no live match anywhere initializes a HexGrid/TownRegistry yet, so nothing in a live game calls this today, named as real follow-up along with the founder's own capture-node card idea (needs zero new mechanics -- town_attempt_convert's existing arbitrary attempt_strength already does exactly that). Win condition resolved (was 'genuinely undecided' in Phase 1): town_registry_faction_has_full_control -- ECOWAR's base game mode is capping every active town at once, a deliberate contrast with REDGARDEN's pace/comeback dynamic; other modes (resource race) named as later, separate work. Card-UI redesign (G-key Hearthstone/Clash-Royale-style draggable panel, drag-to-battlefield-cast vs drag-to-hexgrid-spawn) captured as real founder direction in the NORTHSTAR doc, not built this pass -- client SDL2/OpenGL work with no display available in this sandbox to verify. 43 new tests across tests/test_creep.c and tests/test_walled_hamlet.c (101 total Living Map test assertions across all 4 files), all passing via scripts/test_livingmap.sh (updated to loop over all 4 living-map test binaries) and packages/livingmap/BUILD.bazel's :living_map cc_library (still not locally verified against bazel itself). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
